assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 RPG scene style study, Common Table.
Input image1: style, camera and technology-handling reference ONLY. Use its mature dark charcoal/umber physical watercolor, broad pigment shapes, selective mid-level machine detail, local amber task lights, open playable floor, near-parallel overhead view. Create a completely NEW monastery provision hall, not the reference railway station. Do not reproduce trains, freight containers, station barrier or reference topology.
Scene: a European municipal industrial hall repurposed by a small monastic care community into a shared meal and provision room. Elevated overhead three-quarter oblique/trimetric near-parallel view, continuous floor filling landscape frame, roof/wall cutaway to see playfield, consistent small human scale, no horizon or vanishing point or floating diorama.
Architecture: tall square concrete piers, upper service gallery with simple black rails and a utilitarian staircase at left. Broad open midtone floor with clean paths linking people, tables, food machines and washing area.
Central story technology: along upper-right wall is a LARGE distinctive pale ceramic/enamel modular food dispenser assembly. Precisely assembled municipal infrastructure: recessed small amber dispensing lamps, rectangular replaceable service cassette with latches, visible compact couplers and jointed folding tray arms presenting filled bowls. Components readable selectively, medium detail, handmade watercolor edges rather than glossy CGI. A sealed dark machine service lane behind the dispenser wall glimpsed through a narrow service opening; machine maintenance arranged coolly and orderly. This installed municipal provision system quietly feeds the community, for reasons the picture does not explain.
Human foreground: two shared worn wooden tables, a repaired bench with careful joinery, modest bowls and spoons, a tiny herb pot, a drying cloth near a practical washing basin. Domestic details modest, useful and intentional, not heaps of scrap or decorative medieval treasure.
Exactly FIVE small adult inhabitants: two seated at a shared table eating from bowls; one standing serving a bowl from a dispenser tray; one washing a bowl at basin left; one calmly checking the visible service cassette. Practical modest charcoal/brown robes and work aprons, plain comfortable layers, no theatrical fantasy hoods, no military costumes. Their lives portray sincere monastic care, routine cooperation and thoughtful skilled maintenance. No church crosses, halos, altars or magical ritual.
Lighting/mood: dark charcoal and umber hall, pale gray-ivory enamel and floor, small restrained ochre amber pools focused on food pickup and table. People area feels warm, machinery feels ordered and impersonal. Quiet adult melancholy with dignity; not scary, goofy or triumphant. No neon bath or cinematic bloom.
Medium: physical watercolor on cold-pressed paper; large transparent stains, granulated deep washes, broken drybrush edges, exposed tinted paper floor, selective irregular ink contours on piers and practical machinery. Simplify repetitive bolts and tiny background textures. Do not recreate smooth3D shaded metal covered in texture. Keep machinery legible enough to understand modular dispensing.
No text, labels, UI, watermark, Fallout iconography, generic medieval temple, sci-fi cathedral, mystic runes, magic particles, fire, creatures, added characters. Wide continuous room, grounded connected playable paths.
